name: Ryze
bio: Ryze is the founder and lead developer of RxN Developing, an independent team focused on creating software, automation systems, and custom tools.
He primarily works on the design, programming, and development of solutions for video games, online communities, Windows applications, and digital systems.

name: Ninja
bio: Ninja is a developer and collaborator at RxN Developing. He contributes to the team’s projects by supporting software development, testing, design, and the improvement of technical solutions.

His role may include contributing to bots, automation systems, custom tools, applications, and gaming or technology-focused systems. He works alongside Ryze to transform ideas into concrete, organized, and functional projects.
